prose: Dawn Lester, researcher and author about the connections between consciousness & health, joins InnerVerse for a free-flowing conversation, wherein we discuss the importance of her book, What Really Makes You Ill, and the inspiration behind it, how a healing crisis set Dawn on her spiritual path, alternate interpretations of major illnesses, the flawed nature of prevailing disease theories, ancestral rivers and potential biofield transits with world events, and breaking victimhood mindsets.
ext: We talk about the demonization of the Sun, transcending resistance to emotions, why diagnosis labels are antithetical to health, how to attend to the body's message within discomfort, possibilities of weather warfare, whether or not reality is an illusion, humours and internal/external waters, and what to make of the secret spells in the word magic of English. All that and more!
